name: Surface Survivor
prerequisites: Con 15, gillman, water dependent racial trait
benefit: You lose the water dependent racial trait, but you are sickened if you have not submerged yourself in water within the past 24 hours.
flavor: Due to inherent hardiness and painful training, you can operate indefinitely on land.
text:
Due to inherent hardiness and painful training, you can operate indefinitely on land.

**Prerequisites**: Con 15, gillman, water dependent racial trait.

**Benefit**: You lose the water dependent racial trait, but you are sickened if you have not submerged yourself in water within the past 24 hours.
